title: Chandigarh Youth Skill Development Mission
ministry: Government of Chandigarh - Department of Skill Development & Employment
text:
Scheme: Chandigarh Youth Skill Development Mission - Frequently Asked Questions Q: What is the main objective of the "Skill Development" program? A: The main objective of the "Skill Development" program is to provide practical training and research exposure to postgraduate students in various branches of Earth sciences to enhance their academic and applied skills.

Q: Who implements the "Skill Development" program? A: The "Skill Development" program is implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG), under the Government of India.

Q: Which students are eligible to apply for the "Skill Development" program? A: Students who are pursuing postgraduate degrees or are in the fourth or fifth year of integrated postgraduate programs in Earth sciences or related disciplines are eligible to apply for the program.

Q: What types of Earth science disciplines are covered under this program? A: The program covers a wide range of Earth science disciplines including structural geology, geochemistry, sedimentology, geomorphology, tectonics, environmental geology, economic geology, paleontology, and related fields.

Q: Is there a specific degree requirement for eligibility under the "Skill Development" program? A: Yes, applicants must be pursuing or should have completed a postgraduate degree in any Earth science, geophysics, geology, or allied field.

Q: What kind of training is provided under the "Skill Development" program? A: The program provides hands-on, field-based and laboratory-based training along with participation in institution-led research activities during the training period.

Q: Does the "Skill Development" program include seasonal training opportunities? A: Yes, the program offers both summer and winter training sessions to accommodate the academic calendars of different institutions.

Q: How can students apply for the "Skill Development" program? A: Students can apply through the official [website ](https://www.wihg.res.in/)of the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology where information regarding the program and application instructions are regularly updated.

Q: What are the long-term benefits of attending the "Skill Development" program? text:
Scheme: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
Ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
Level: state
State: Chhattisgarh
Category: Agriculture, Rural & Environment

Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana is a scheme of the Government of Chhattisgarh for the farmers and launched on May 21, 2020, on the death anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi.
The main objective of this scheme is to increase the agricultural area by encouraging the farmers for crop production.
Under this scheme, financial benefits will be transferred to the farmers. This amount will be transferred to the accounts of the farmers in 4 instalments. This scheme started during the Corona period has provided great relief to the farmers. In the initial year of the scheme, only paddy, maize and sugarcane crops were included but after that, few more types of following crops have been included in it.

1. Kodo Kutki.
1. Sugarcane.
1. Arhar.
1. Maize.
1. Soybean.
1. Pulses.
1. Oilseeds.
1. Fragrant paddy.
1. Other fortified rice.
1. Banana.
1. Papaya.

title: Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata

text:
Scheme: Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata - Benefits
Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.

title: Mahtari Vandan Yojana
ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Mahtari Vandan Yojana - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What are the eligibility criteria regarding marital status for applying to this financial assistance scheme?
A: The applicant must be a married woman, widow, divorcee, or abandoned woman who is a local resident of Chhattisgarh.

Q: Is there a minimum age requirement to qualify for the monthly financial assistance?
A: Yes, the applicant must be 21 years or older as of 1st January of the year of application.

Q: How much financial assistance will an eligible woman receive under this scheme?
A: Each eligible beneficiary will receive ₹1,000 per month directly deposited into her Aadhaar-linked bank account.

Q: What happens if a woman already receives some amount under other social assistance programs?
A: If she receives less than ₹1,000, she will get additional assistance to make the total ₹1,000 per month.

Q: How will the financial assistance amount be disbursed to the beneficiaries?
A: The amount will be transferred directly into the applicant’s Aadhaar-linked DBT-enabled bank account.

Q: Is it mandatory to have an Aadhaar-linked bank account to receive the benefits?
A: Yes, the applicant must have her own Aadhaar-linked DBT-based bank account to receive the assistance.

Q: Are there any tax-related exclusions for the applicant’s family under this scheme?
A: Yes, no member of the applicant’s family should be an income taxpayer.

Q: Can a woman apply if any family member is employed by the government?
A: No, if any family member is a government employee (permanent, temporary, or contractual), she is ineligible.

Q: Are former or current MPs or MLAs or their family members eligible for this scheme?
A: No, if any family member is or was an MP, MLA, or held certain government positions, the applicant is excluded.

Q: What documents are required to prove local residency in Chhattisgarh?
A: Acceptable documents include a residence certificate, ration card, or voter ID card.

Q: Is a marriage certificate mandatory for married women applying to the scheme?
A: Yes, a marriage certificate or a certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat/local bodies is required.

Q: What proof is needed if a woman is abandoned by her husband?
A: An abandoned woman must submit a certificate issued by the society/ward/Gram Panchayat as proof.

Q: Which documents can be submitted as proof of age for the applicant?
A: Acceptable documents include a birth certificate, 10th/12th marksheet, PAN card, voter ID, or driving license.

Q: Do applicants need to submit a self-declaration or affidavit?
A: Yes, a self-declaration form or affidavit must be attached with the application.

title: Mukhyamantri Pension Yojana
ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Social Welfare
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Pension Yojana - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Which Department Manages This Scheme?
A: This scheme is managed by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development, Govt. of Jharkhand.

Q: Is This Scheme State Sponsored Or Centrally Sponsored?
A: This scheme is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme.

Q: Where Can I Find The Link To The Scheme Guidelines?
A: The Scheme Guidelines can be found at this link - https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in/schemmeDetailsShow.action

Q: Can Women Also Apply To This Scheme?
A: Yes, this scheme is open to applicants from all genders.

Q: Does This Scheme Accept Offline Applications?
A: No, this scheme only accepts online applications. In order to apply, please register yourself on the Official website of Comprehensive Labour Management System for Factory Establishment / Worker Registration / Inspection / Management & Grievance Redressal; Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development; Govt. of Jharkhand.

Q: What Is The URL Of The Website Of Comprehensive Labour Management System For Factory Establishment/Worker Registration/Inspection/Management & Grievance Redressal?
A: The URL of the website of Comprehensive Labour Management System for Factory Establishment / Worker Registration / Inspection / Management & Grievance Redressal is https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in/home.

Q: What Details Are Required To Register On The Portal?
A: The following details are required to register on the portal - First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile, Username and Password.

Q: What Details Are Needed To Be Provided In The "Basic Details" Section Of The Application Form?
A: The following details are needed to be provided in the "Basic Details" section of the Application Form: BOC Registration Number, Applicant's Name, Applicant's Father's Name / Husband's Name, Applicant's Date of Birth, Applicant's Aadhaar Number, District, Sex.

Q: How Do I Know If A Field Is Mandatory?
A: The mandatory fields are marked with a "Red Asterisk" (*) at the end.

Q: Is There Any Application Fee?
A: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

Q: How Do I Track The Status Of My Application?
A: To track the status of your application, follow the stepwise process given below: Step 1: Once submitted, the application goes for 3-level approval: Clerk > Labour Superintendent > DLC. Step 2: Go to Services > BOC Scheme Benefit > Application Status. Step 3: On the next page, fill in your Application ID, and click "Search". The status of your application will be displayed in a tabular format: Application ID, Applicant Name, Scheme Applied, Application Status, Remarks, Date, and Time. Step 4: Once the DLC approves the application, the "Application Status" changes to "Approved". The Applicant can take print of this page by clicking "PRINT" and submit the same at the Labour Office to avail of the scheme benefit.

Q: How Many Schemes Can Be Selected At A Time From The List Of Schemes In The Application Form?
A: The application form allows only one scheme to be selected per application.

Q: Is There A Percentage Of Slots Reserved For Female Applicants?
A: No, there is no reservation of slots based on the gender of the applicant.

Q: By When Can The Applicant Receive The Scheme Benefits?
A: The benefits are due within three months of registration.

Q: Can A Person Who Is Domiciled In Madhya Pradesh Also Apply To This Scheme?
A: No, this scheme is open to applicants who are domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.

Q: Is It Mandatory For The Applicant To Be A Registered Construction Worker (Nirman Shramik) In Order To Be Eligible To Apply?
A: Yes, in order to be eligible to apply, the applicant should be a Registered Construction Worker (Nirman Shramik).

Q: Where Can I Find The Link To The User Manual Of The Application Process?

title: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata
ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Commerce & MSME
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata - Eligibility
Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.

1. The girl's father or mother or both should be registered as a construction worker in the Board for a period of at least one year.
1. The daughter for whom application has been made should not be registered in any division under the Labor Department.
1. Only two daughters of registered construction workers will be eligible for incentive amount.
1. The age of the daughter should be at least 18 years and should not be more than 21 years. 
1. Daughter should be unmarried.
1. The daughter must have passed at least 10th class. 
1. There should be a running bank account in the name of the daughter
1. The Parents of the daughter must have been working as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the period of one year preceding the date of application.
1. For payment of incentive amount, self-declaration form will be mandatory regarding verification of the beneficiary being a construction worker and the information given by the applicant in the application.
1. Those girls beneficiaries who have already received assistance under Minimata Kanya Vivah Yojana/Rajmata Vijayaraje Kanya Vivah Assistance Yojana operated under the Board, will be not eligible for this scheme.


Age: 18 to 55 years
Gender: male, female, transgender
Income: below-1l, 1l-2.5l, 2.5l-5l

text:
Scheme: DNH Coastal Housing Assistance - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the Housing Assistance Scheme?
A: It provides housing support to tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometown where hostels are not available.

Q: Who is eligible for this scheme?
A: Tribal students from Madhya Pradesh who have passed class 12th and are enrolled in higher education courses.

Q: Does the scheme cover technical and paramedical courses?
A: Yes, the scheme includes technical, paramedical, graduate, and graduate diploma courses.

Q: Can students in private colleges apply for this scheme?
A: Yes, students in non-government colleges are eligible.

Q: Is the scheme available to students who are already staying in government hostels?
A: No, the scheme is only for students who have not received admission to government hostels.

Q: What type of financial support is provided?
A: Housing assistance is provided to cover accommodation costs for eligible students.

Q: Is there an income limit for eligibility?
A: The scheme does not specify an income limit, but applicants must meet other eligibility criteria.

Q: Can students from all districts of Madhya Pradesh apply?
A: Yes, students from any district in Madhya Pradesh who meet the criteria can apply.

Q: How do students apply for the scheme?
A: Applications can be submitted through the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of Madhya Pradesh.

Q: Is the scheme available for postgraduate students?
A: The scheme is primarily for students pursuing graduate-level courses and specific diplomas. Postgraduate eligibility may depend on the course and department guidelines.

2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **90 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum, ₹5,00,000 to ₹8,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Self-employed, Unemployed, Homemaker, Retired.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

A: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals from marginalized sections for the construction of their own houses and improve their living conditions.

Q: What Is The Maximum Income Limit For Eligibility Under This Scheme?
A: The maximum annual income limit for eligibility under this scheme is Rs. 3.00 lakhs.

Q: Can A Person Avail Of This Subsidy More Than Once?
A: No, a person cannot avail of this subsidy more than once.

Q: What Is A Bonafide Himachali Certificate?
A: A bonafide Himachali certificate is a document that certifies an individual's permanent residence in Himachal Pradesh.

text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Pratibha Yojana - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Who is eligible for the Pratibha Yojana?
A: To be eligible, you must be a native of Madhya Pradesh, belong to the Scheduled Tribe category, have an annual family income not exceeding [?]6,00,000, have qualified in national competitive exams like JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, or NDA, and have taken admission in specified institutions.

Q: What types of financial assistance are provided under the scheme?
A: Students with an annual parental income up to [?]3,00,000/- are provided [?]50,000/-. Students with an annual parental income exceeding [?]3,00,000/- receive [?]25,000/-.

Q: Which national competitive examinations qualify for this scheme?
A: The qualifying examinations include JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, and NDA.

Q: Which institutions are covered under the Pratibha Yojana?
A: IIT/NIT (through JEE), Government colleges in Madhya Pradesh for MBBS (through NEET), AIIMS, NLU (through CLAT), and NDA (through UPSC).

Q: What documents are needed to apply?
A: Aadhaar-linked bank account details, receipt of admission to the institute, proof of Scheduled Tribe status, and proof of family income, etc.

Q: How is the financial assistance paid?
A: The incentive amount is paid directly into the applicant's bank account linked to Aadhaar.

Q: How can one apply for the Pratibha Yojana?
A: Eligible students should apply through the online portal of the Madhya Pradesh Tribal Affairs & Scheduled Caste Welfare Automation System (MPTAASC). https://www.tribal.mp.gov.in/MPTAAS

Q: Is it mandatory to register on the online portal?
A: Yes, it is mandatory to register the beneficiary profile on the MPTAASC portal.

Q: How will I know the status of my application?
A: Current status information will be sent to the registered email and mobile number via SMS. The applicants may also login to the MPTAASC portal to know their application status.

Q: What should I do if I face issues while applying?
A: Contact the helpdesk at 1800-2333-951 or email helpdesk.tribal@mp.gov.in for assistance.

Q: Can students from other states apply for this scheme?
A: No, only students who are natives of Madhya Pradesh are eligible.

**Delhi Ladli Scheme** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Delhi - Department of Women & Child Development** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Delhi.

The scheme was established under the **Women & Child** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.

title: Delhi Pension Scheme for Senior Citizens
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Social Welfare
text:
Scheme: Delhi Pension Scheme for Senior Citizens - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
A: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

Q: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
A: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

Q: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
A: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

Q: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
A: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

Q: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

Q: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
A: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

Q: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
A: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

Q: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: No, as per the guidelines, there is no fee required for the registration.

Q: How to enroll as a beneficiary under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: Applicants can visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to enroll themselves as a beneficiary under the board: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

Q: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
A: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

Q: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
A: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

Q: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
A: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

Q: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
A: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

Q: Why is it important to inform the Board about the death of a pensioner?
A: Informing the Board about the death of a pensioner is important to ensure that the pension payments are stopped, and the pensioner's bank account is properly closed, preventing any unauthorized transactions.

Q: What documents are required to notify the Board about the death of a pensioner?
A: The legal dependents or heirs need to provide the death certificate of the pensioner to the BOCW Welfare Board.

Q: How to apply for the assistance under this scheme?
A: Applicants should visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to avail the assistance under this scheme: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

The objective of the scheme is to provide quality coaching for economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs) candidates to enable them to compete in Competitive examinations and succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in the Public/Private sector.
**The courses for which the Coaching will be imparted shall be as follows:**

- Group A and B examinations are conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), the Staff Selection Commission (SSC), various Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), and Judicial Services Examination.
- Group A and B examinations conducted by the State Public Service Commission;
- Officers’ Grade examinations conducted by Banks, Insurance Companies, and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
- Premier Entrance Examinations for admission in (a) engineering (e.g. IIT-JEE &amp; AIEEE), (b) Medical (e.g. AIPMT), (c) professional courses like Management (e.g. CAT) and Law (e.g. CLAT) and (d) such other disciplines, Government may decide from time to time.

title: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Skill Development & Employment
text:
Scheme: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas - Benefits
Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
1. A monthly stipend of ₹2500/- per student will be paid for local students for attending the coaching classes. 
   1. Under the scheme, 75% of the admissible coaching fee amount is to be provided by the Government and the remaining 25% is to be borne by the students. 
   1. In case of students having a total family income of up to ₹2.00 lacs, a full admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt.

**Note 01:** The institute would have to pay a stipend to each student on a monthly basis through PFMS/ ECS or cheque. Cash payment would not be allowed.
**Note 02:** Benefits under the scheme can be availed by a particular student not more than twice, irrespective of the number of chances; he/she may be entitled to in a particular competitive examination. However, only 50 % of the admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt. for students who avail of 2nd time coaching facility under the scheme. The coaching institution will also be required to take an undertaking from the students that they have not taken benefit more than twice under the scheme.

title: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Skill Development & Employment
text:
Scheme: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas - Eligibility
Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
**Eligibility criteria for students:**

   1. Only students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category residing in Delhi &amp; who have passed 10th and 12th class (or studying in class XII) from the schools in Delhi, having a total family income of not more than ₹6.00 lakh per annum will be eligible under the scheme.
   1. The students must have secured a prescribed percentage of marks in the qualifying examinations for which free coaching is proposed to be imparted under the scheme.

**Note 01:** Sponsoring Department may also nominate some needy students for coaching under the selected institutions.
**Note 02:** Income and Caste Certificates issued by the office of the concerned District Magistrate should be obtained from the Students by the selected institutes.
**Note 03:** Where examination is conducted in two stages viz. Preliminary and Main, the candidates will be entitled to free coaching for both examinations. They will be entitled to free coaching for both Preliminary and Main examinations at their convenience. However, there will be no restriction on the number of chances for coaching for interview, if the candidate is selected for interview.
**Note 04:** The selected students shall have to attend all classes. In the event of any student remaining absent for more than 15 days, without any valid reason, the benefits of free coaching to him/her shall be discontinued and another student shall be taken in his/her place.
**Eligibility criteria for applying for Empanelment of Coaching Institutions:**

   1. The institute should be a registered body or run by any organization registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860/ Companies Act, 2013, or any other relevant Act of the State/Union Territory.
   1. The institute should have experience of at least 3 years as of the date of notification inviting applications from institutions for empanelment by the Department.
   1. The institute should have been fully functional for a minimum period of 3 years at the time of applying under this scheme and having a minimum enrolment of 100 students in the courses each year for at least two years, immediately prior to the year in which selected for empanelment.
   1. The institute must have the proper infrastructure to meet the entire requirement for providing quality coaching in the courses applied.

title: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY)
ministry: Government of Goa - Department of Health & Family Welfare
text: Scheme: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY) - Benefits Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals. **The benefit under this scheme shall be provided on a cashless basis to the beneficiaries, up to the limit of their annual coverage, and shall be as under:** 1. The insurance cover shall be up to ₹2,50,000/- per annum for a family of three or fewer members and up to ₹4,00,000/- for a family of four or more members. Under no case, the claim would exceed ₹4,00,000/- annually. 1. The insurance benefit can be availed of individually or collectively by members of the family. 1. An individual is free to take higher coverage from the insurance company by paying higher premiums, without having any impact on Government policy and facilities. 1. The facilities for 447 procedures shall be covered under the scheme.

text:
Scheme: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY) - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the objective of the DDSSY scheme?
A: The objective of the DDSSY scheme is to provide quality medical care and treatment, including hospitalization and surgeries, to the residents of Goa through government and private hospitals on a cashless basis.

Q: Who is eligible for the DDSSY scheme?
A: The scheme covers all residents of Goa who have lived in the state for five years or more.

Q: What is the insurance coverage provided under DDSSY?
A: The insurance cover is up to [?]2,50,000/- per annum for a family of three or fewer members and up to [?]4,00,000/- for a family of four or more members. The maximum claim cannot exceed [?]4,00,000/- annually.

Q: What documents are required to avail of the DDSSY scheme?
A: Required documents include an Aadhar Card or enrolment slip, proof of residence in Goa for five years, a ration card to define the family, and additional documents for specific categories like caste certificates or disability certificates.

Q: How can a beneficiary avail of the benefits under the DDSSY scheme?
A: Beneficiaries can approach an Empanelled Health Care Provider (EHCP) listed on the DDSSY website. After consulting with a doctor, the hospital's DDSSY Sahayak will raise a pre-authorization request for the required procedure.

Q: Can a beneficiary opt for higher insurance coverage?
A: Yes, individuals can opt for higher insurance coverage by paying an additional premium directly to the insurance company, without affecting the government-provided benefits.

Q: How many medical procedures are covered under the DDSSY scheme?
A: The scheme covers 447 medical procedures.

Q: What should a beneficiary do if they are aware of the required procedure?
A: If aware of the required procedure, beneficiaries can check the DDSSY website for a list of EHCPs performing that procedure and visit the hospital of their choice from the empanelled list.

Q: Where can applications for the DDSSY scheme be submitted?
A: Applications can be submitted at Goa Electronics Ltd., Ground Floor, Shrama Shakti Bhavan, Patto Plaza, EDC Complex, Panaji, Goa.

Q: Who should be contacted for more information about the DDSSY scheme?
A: For more information, beneficiaries can contact the DDSSY helpline at 0832-2438844 or email ddssydhs@gmail.com. The website ddssygoa.mdindia.com also provides detailed information.

title: Griha Aadhar Scheme
ministry: Government of Goa - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Griha Aadhar Scheme - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Who Is Considered A _Married Woman_ Under The Scheme's Eligibility Criteria
A: The term "married woman" includes not only a woman who is currently married but also widows and divorcees. All these categories of women are eligible for the scheme, provided their gross income does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.

Q: How Is The "Gross Income" Of The Beneficiary Defined For The Purpose Of Eligibility Assessment?
A: The term "gross income" refers to all income received by the beneficiary, such as salary, remuneration, earnings from profession, agriculture, business, or any other source of income. It includes all income before considering any statutory, essential, or other deductions that are required to be made from the gross income.

Q: Are Widows And Divorcees Subject To The Same Income Limit As Married Women For Eligibility?
A: Yes, widows and divorcees are subject to the same income limit of Rs. 3,00,000 per annum for eligibility under the scheme. As long as their gross income does not exceed this limit, they are eligible to avail the benefits.

Q: Can You Provide Examples Of Income Sources Considered Under The Term "Gross Income"?
A: "Gross income" includes various sources of earnings such as salary from employment, remuneration from work, income generated from professions, earnings from agriculture or business activities, and any other income received from various sources.

Q: How Are Deductions Accounted For While Calculating The Gross Income For Eligibility?
A: While calculating the gross income, no deductions for statutory, essential, or any other purposes are taken into account. The income considered is the total income before any deductions are made.

Q: What Happens If The Beneficiary Fails To Submit The Life Certificate And Income Certificate As Required By The Scheme?
A: If the beneficiary fails to submit the required Life Certificate and Income Certificate, the monthly financial assistance will be stopped immediately. However, upon receipt of the necessary certificates and meeting other conditions, the assistance will be resumed from the next month.

Q: What Happens If The Beneficiary Does Not Withdraw The Financial Assistance For 6 Months Or More?
A: If the beneficiary does not withdraw the financial assistance for a continuous period of 6 months or more, the accumulated amount will be reversed and issued in the form of a Demand Draft in favor of the Director, Directorate of Women & Child Development by the concerned bank.

Q: What Are The Consequences Of Availing Benefits Under The Scheme Based On Incorrect Information Or False Declaration?
A: If any beneficiary avails benefits under the scheme by providing wrong or false information, legal action will be initiated against them, and they will be disqualified from receiving benefits under any other government schemes.

Q: How Is The Scheme's Implementation Facilitated To Address Any Difficulties That May Arise?
A: A4: To handle any difficulties in implementing the scheme, a four-member committee has been constituted. The committee includes the Secretary (Women and Child Development) as Chairperson, a Social Worker appointed by the Government as Member, an Additional/Joint Secretary (Finance) as Member, and the Director of Women and Child Development as Member Secretary. The committee's decisions are final and binding on all concerned.

Q: How Is The Financial Assistance Disbursed To The Beneficiaries?
A: The financial assistance of Rs. 1500/- is directly paid into the savings bank account of the eligible beneficiary through ABPS/ACH/NEFT every month.

Q: Can Widows And Divorcees Avail Of The Benefits Of This Scheme?
A: Yes, the term 'married woman' in the scheme includes widows and divorcees as well. As long as their gross income does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000/- per annum, they are eligible for the financial assistance.

Q: How Is The Financial Assistance Paid To The Beneficiaries?
A: The financial assistance is paid every month directly into the savings bank account of the eligible beneficiary through ABPS (Aadhar Bridge Payment System)/ACH (Automated Credit House)/NEFT (National Electronic Fund Transfer) subject to other conditions.

Q: How Much Financial Assistance Is Provided Under The Scheme?
A: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly disbursement of Rs. 1500/- (Rupees one thousand five hundred only).

Scheme: Goa Rural Housing Subsidy Scheme - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the Gujarat Housing Subsidy Scheme?
A: The Gujarat Housing Subsidy Scheme is a program initiated by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker's Welfare Board (GBOCWWB) to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for building their own houses.

Q: What are the benefits provided under the scheme?
A: Registered construction workers can receive an assistance of [?]1,50,000/- over a duration of 5 years, with [?]30,000/- disbursed annually, subject to the terms of assistance.

Q: Who is eligible to benefit from the scheme?
A: Construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker's Welfare Board are eligible to avail the benefits of the scheme.

Q: What is the minimum registration period required to apply for the scheme?
A: Applicants must have a minimum of 2 years of registration with the construction worker's board at the time of applying for scheme benefits.

A: The application must be made within one year from the date of the document mentioned in the house purchase document, provided it's after the scheme's resolution date of 29/06/2020.

A: Yes, the maximum loan amount for house purchase should not exceed [?]15 lakh, and the loan tenure should be 10 years or more.

A: No, registered construction workers who already own a house or property in joint ownership are not eligible for the scheme benefits.

Q: Is there a requirement to renew the application annually?

**Dayanand Social Security Scheme** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Goa - Department of Social Welfare** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Goa.

Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

text:
Scheme: Dayanand Social Security Scheme - Benefits
Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
Ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
Level: state
State: Gujarat
Category: Agriculture, Rural & Environment

**Details**
Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana is implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department. The Revenue Department is responsible for the implementation of the scheme, including the verification of crop damage and the disbursal of compensation to eligible farmers. The Agriculture and Co-operation Department provides technical assistance and support for the implementation of the scheme to ensure that farmers receive timely and adequate relief in case of crop damage due to natural calamities.
<br>

**Key Points**

   1. The main objective behind launching this scheme is to provide financial assistance to farmers of Gujarat in case of crop loss.
   1. Financial Assistance will only be provided to farmers if Crop Loss is due to natural calamities.
   1. No premium will have to pay by the farmers to get themselves registered under Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana.
   1. Financial Assistance will only be paid up to a maximum of 4 Hectares of Agricultural Land.
   1. Eligible Farmers can apply by visiting their nearest E Gram Centre to avail the benefit of financial assistance in case of crop loss.

<br>

Small and marginal farmers holding verified land records in the state.
**Eligibility** 

1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Gujarat state.
1. The applicant must have availed of a loan for agricultural purposes from a cooperative institution or a bank.
1. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake.
1. The applicant must possess the land for agricultural purposes in his/her name or have the right to cultivate such land.
1. The land should be surveyed by the Revenue Department of Gujarat and should have a record of rights.
1. The crop loss should be certified by the Revenue Department of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have insured the crop under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana or any other crop insurance scheme recognized by the Government of Gujarat.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana - Application Process
Mode: Online
URL: https://agri.gujarat.gov.in/
Application Process
Visit the 
official website
 of the Gujarat government's agriculture department.
Navigate to the Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana page.
Download the application form for the scheme.
Fill in the application form with accurate details.
Attach the required documents such as proof of land ownership, crop loss certificate, and bank loan documents.
Submit the application form along with the supporting documents to the nearest agricultural office or bank branch.

Mode: Offline
Application Process
Farmers need to visit their nearest E Gram Centre to apply for financial assistance under Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana in case of crop loss due to natural calamity.
The assistant present at the centre will fill out the application form for farmers free of cost.
Aadhar Card and Proof of Land Records are mandatorily needed to fill out the application form.
Once the Application Form is finally submitted, the assistant will provide a printout of the application form to the farmer.
The application Form along with all the documents will be forwarded to District Agriculture Officer for verification.
District Agriculture Officer will do physical verification of the agricultural field and access the crop loss of the farmer.
Then DAO submits its report to the Department of Agriculture for final approval.
After final approval from the department, the amount of financial assistance will be transferred to the given bank account of the farmer.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the maximum amount of financial assistance that a farmer can receive under this scheme?
A: The maximum amount of financial assistance that a farmer can receive under the scheme is Rs. 20,000 per hectare, subject to a maximum of four hectares per farmer.

Q: How is the financial assistance calculated under this scheme?
A: The financial assistance is calculated based on the extent of crop damage suffered by the farmer. The extent of crop damage is assessed by a team of officials appointed by the government, who take into account various factors such as the type of crop, the stage of crop growth, and the severity of the natural calamity.

Q: What types of crops are covered under this scheme?
A: All crops, including horticultural crops, are covered under this scheme.

Q: Is there any income criterion for availing of the financial assistance under this scheme?
A: No, there is no income criterion for availing of the financial assistance under this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

Q: How long does it take to receive the financial assistance under this scheme?
A: The government aims to disburse the financial assistance within 30 days from the date of submission of the application, provided that all the required documents and information are submitted correctly.

Q: Can a farmer apply for financial assistance under this scheme for crop loss suffered in the previous year?
A: No, financial assistance can only be availed for crop loss suffered in the current year. However, in exceptional cases, the government may consider applications for the previous year's crop loss, subject to the availability of funds.

Q: What is the age limit for availing of the benefits of this scheme?
A: There is no age limit for availing of the benefits of this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

Q: Can a farmer who has already received compensation from another government scheme for crop loss apply for this scheme?
A: No, a farmer who has already received compensation or financial assistance from any other government scheme or insurance policy for the same crop loss is not eligible to apply for this scheme.

Q: Is it mandatory for the farmer to have taken a loan for agricultural purposes to be eligible for this scheme?
A: No, it is not mandatory for the farmer to have taken a loan for agricultural purposes to be eligible for this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

Q: What is the minimum landholding size required for a farmer to be eligible for this scheme?
A: There is no minimum landholding size required for a farmer to be eligible for this scheme. However, the farmer must have legal ownership or a record of rights for the land used for agricultural purposes.

Q: Can a farmer who has not insured their crops under any crop insurance scheme still apply for this scheme?
A: Yes, a farmer who has not insured their crops under any crop insurance scheme can still apply for this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

Q: Is it necessary for the farmer to have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake to be eligible for this scheme?
A: Yes, it is necessary for the farmer to have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake to be eligible for this scheme.

Q: How can Farmer apply for Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana? 
A: Farmers can apply for this scheme by visiting the official website of the Revenue Department of Gujarat, downloading the application form, and submitting it along with the required documents to the nearest agricultural office or bank branch.

Q: What are the required documents for applying to this scheme? 
A: The required documents for applying to this scheme include proof of land ownership, crop loss certificate, bank loan documents, and other relevant documents as specified in the application form.

Q: Can Farmer apply for this scheme offline? 
A: Yes, Farmers can also apply for this scheme by visiting the Taluka Mamlatdar's office or the District Collector's office to obtain the application form.

Q: Is there any application fee for this scheme? 
A: No, there is no application fee for this scheme.

Q: What is the timeline for processing the application? 
A: The timeline for processing the application varies, but it generally takes a few weeks to process the application and disburse the financial assistance to eligible farmers

Q: Can Farmers apply for this scheme if he have not suffered crop loss due to natural calamities? 
A: No, this scheme is specifically designed to provide financial assistance to farmers who have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake. If Farmers have not suffered such losses, they may not be eligible for this scheme.

text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
Ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Higher & School Education
Level: state
State: Gujarat
Category: Education & Learning

**Detailed** 
Mukhymantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana or MYSY Scholarship is a scholarship scheme that is offered to the economically weaker section students of Gujarat. All those students who wish to pursue higher education like diploma courses, engineering, pharmacy course, medical course, etc apply for MYSY scholarship every year.
<br>

**Objective**
The main objective of the MYSY Scholarship Scheme is to help those students financially who are not being able to finance their education due to low family income. Through this scholarship scheme, financial assistance will be provided to those students so that they can continue their education without any problem.
<br>

**Types of Scholarship Under MYSY Scholarship**
There are three types of scholarships that are offered under the MYSY Scholarship which are as follows:-

   1. Tuition fee grant
   1. Hostel grant
   1. Book/instruments grant

<br>

**Features and Benefits of the MYSY Scholarship**

   1. Under the MYSY scholarship scheme, non-reserve students will also get financial help for buying books and equipment.
   1. Those students who are in Gujarat medical education research society and dental courses will get financial assistance of Rs 10 lakh over 5 years
   1. For government jobs, there is an age relaxation given to all category students. This age relaxation is of 5 years
   1. All those students who wish to appear in the competitive exam will be provided training under training centers.
   1. The government will also provide assistance of Rs 1200 per month for 10 months if in that region there is no higher education facility or government hostel.
   1. All the students who have passed class 10th and 12th with 80% and have opted for diploma courses will get Rs 25000 per year or 50% fees whichever is less.
   1. Under the MYSY scholarship scheme free of cost outfits, reading material etc will be provided by the government

<br>

**MAA Amrutam / MAA Vatsalya Scheme** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Gujarat - Department of Health & Family Welfare** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Gujarat.

The scheme was established under the **Health & Wellness** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.

title: MAA Amrutam / MAA Vatsalya Scheme
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Health & Family Welfare
text:
Scheme: MAA Amrutam / MAA Vatsalya Scheme - Benefits
Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.

Scheme: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
Ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Housing & Urban Development
Level: state
State: Gujarat
Category: Housing & Shelter

The scheme &quot;Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana&quot; was launched by the Director of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice &amp; Empowerment, Government of Gujarat, in the year 1999. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- is provided to Scheduled Caste individuals who do not own a residential home, have an old rough residential home, or own a plot for residence, and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category for the construction of a house. The assistance will be paid in three installments to economically weaker Scheduled Caste individuals, especially those below the poverty line, in both urban and rural areas for house construction on an individual basis.
**Implementing Agency:**
**In Urban Areas**: District Deputy Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare Office
**In Rural Areas:** District Social Welfare Officer Office

title: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Housing & Urban Development
text:
Scheme: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana - Benefits
Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
1. Under the scheme, individuals belonging to the scheduled caste category are provided with ₹1,20,000/- assistance for the construction of houses in both urban and rural areas.
   1. The assistance will be paid in three instalments, first instalment is ₹40,000/- (with order of administrative sanction), the second instalment is ₹60,000/- (after reaching the lintel level), and the third instalment is ₹20,000/- (On completion of construction, including toilets).

title: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Housing & Urban Development
text:
Scheme: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana - Eligibility
Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.

   1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
   1. Economically weaker Scheduled Caste individuals, especially those below the poverty line are eligible to receive benefits under the scheme.
   1. The beneficiary should not own a residential home, possess an old rough residential home, or have their own plot for residence.
   1. The applicant or any other family members of the applicant should not have already received benefits under any other housing scheme implemented by the Government.
   1. The annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- in rural area and ₹6,00,000/- in urban area.
   1. Those who are eligible for ₹12,000 assistance for toilets will be eligible for it separately as per the rules of the scheme. However, if the beneficiary is not eligible for assistance for a toilet, he/she will have to construct a toilet out which is mandatory for assistance of ₹1,20,000/-.
   1. On the house built under this scheme, the beneficiary will have to put a plaque as per “State Government&#39;s Ambedkar Awas Yojana”.
   1. The upper limit on construction of houses will be ₹10,00,000/- for urban areas and ₹7,00,000/- for rural areas. The ceiling limit will not apply to the assistance provided under the Affordable Housing Scheme in urban areas.
   1. The construction of the house has to be completed within 2 years from the payment of the first installment of the housing assistance.
   1. The age of the beneficiary will be at least 21 years.
   1. A scheduled caste beneficiary can also be given the benefit under this scheme if his adult sons or brother builds a house on the first floor of the person whose name currently has a house on the ground floor to build his own house with the consent of the house owner/landlord. 
   1. If the entire construction of the house cannot be completed with the assistance received under the &quot;Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana,&quot; the beneficiary will need to contribute the remaining amount to ensure the completion of the construction of the house.

ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Social Welfare
text:
Scheme: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
A: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

Q: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
A: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

Q: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
A: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

Q: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
A: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

Q: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

Q: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
A: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

Q: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
A: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

Q: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: No, as per the guidelines, there is no fee required for the registration.

Q: How to enroll as a beneficiary under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
A: Applicants can visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to enroll themselves as a beneficiary under the board: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

Q: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
A: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

Q: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
A: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

Q: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
A: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

Q: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
A: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

Q: Why is it important to inform the Board about the death of a pensioner?
A: Informing the Board about the death of a pensioner is important to ensure that the pension payments are stopped, and the pensioner's bank account is properly closed, preventing any unauthorized transactions.

Q: What documents are required to notify the Board about the death of a pensioner?
A: The legal dependents or heirs need to provide the death certificate of the pensioner to the BOCW Welfare Board.

Q: How to apply for the assistance under this scheme?
A: Applicants should visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to avail the assistance under this scheme: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

A: Yes, the loan can be used for any type of business, including manufacturing, service, or trading

A: No, there is no income limit for women entrepreneurs to apply for the scheme. It is open to women from all income groups

A: Yes, the applicant should be 18 years of age or above to apply for the scheme.

Q: What is the minimum educational qualification required to apply for the scheme?
A: The applicant should have passed at least 8th standard to be eligible for the scheme.

Q: Is the scheme open to women entrepreneurs from all income groups?
A: Yes, the scheme is open to women entrepreneurs from all income groups. There is no income limit for applying for the scheme.

Q: Is it mandatory to have a business plan to apply for the scheme?
A: Yes, it is mandatory to submit a detailed business plan along with the application form. The plan should include the type of business, investment required, and expected revenue

text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
Ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Women & Child Development
Level: state
State: Haryana
Category: Women & Child

Launched in 2021, the scheme "Shagun Yojna" by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families for the marriage of their daughters. Under this scheme, a marriage grant is provided to parents, guardians, or the girl herself if her parents are not alive or traceable. The scheme is implemented by the District Programme Officer through the Child Development Project Officer.
***Objectives:***

- To support BPL families with financial assistance for the marriage of girls above 18 years of age.
- To ensure that eligible girls receive aid even if marrying outside Himachal Pradesh.

title: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana - Benefits
Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
- A one-time financial grant of ₹31,000 is provided for the marriage of BPL girls/women.

**NOTE:**

- The grant is given to parents/guardians or the girl herself (if her parents are not alive/traceable).
- The grant can be disbursed up to 2 months before the proposed date of marriage.
- If the marriage has already taken place, the grant may be claimed within 6 months of the marriage date.

title: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana - Eligibility
Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.

1. The girl applicant must be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The girl must be 18 years of age or above at the time of marriage.
1. The marriage grant will be given even if the girl from Himachal Pradesh is marrying a boy from outside the state of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The family of the applicant girl must be living below the poverty line (BPL). 
1. If the parents of the girl are not alive or traceable, the girl herself can apply.
1. The groom must be above 21 years of age.
1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna or any other similar departmental marriage grant scheme.
1. Those destitute left out women who are not financially able to perform their re-marriage can also apply.


Age: 18 to 60 years
Gender: female
Income: below-1l, 1l-2.5l
Social Category: general, sc, st, obc
Occupation: homemaker, unemployed, farmer
Area: urban, rural

text:

Applicants have to go to the 
official website
 of the e-district Himachal Pradesh.
On the home page, click on the option of Citizen Login and New Registration.
On the new page, applicants will have to enter the required details and upload photo identity proof with a profile image.
Now applicants log in again by clicking on the option of Citizen Login.
Applicants have to enter their Udar ID password and select the user type.
Now applicants have to click on the option of Himachal Pradesh Vivah Shagun Yojana Apply here. 
Now the application form will open on the screen.
Applicants have to enter all the important information asked in this application form.
Upload all the important documents and submit

Mode: Offline
Application Process:
Obtain Application Form:
Collect the prescribed form (Annexure "A") from the local office of the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), Nari Sewa Sadan, or Balika Ashram.
OR
The applicant may download the application form 
(Annexure "A")
 from the official website.
Fill and Attach Documents:
Fill out the form and attach all required documents as listed above.
Submit Application:
Submit the completed application to the CDPO/Incharge of Nari Sewa Sadan/Superintendent of Balika Ashram.
NOTE:
The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of marriage to be considered or two months prior to the proposed marriage date. 
Verification Process:
The verifying authority checks all details and ensures the applicant has not received similar benefits from other schemes.
Sanction and Disbursement:
The District Programme Officer sanctions the grant.
The sanctioned amount is transferred to the CDPO, who disburses it into the applicant’s bank account.
If the application is approved before the marriage, the amount may be disbursed up to two months in advance.

text:

A: For this scheme, permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh living below the poor line can apply for financial assistance for the marriage of their daughters.

Q: What Is The Minimum Age Of Girl To Avail The Benefits Of The Shagun Yojna ?
A: The Minimum Age Of The Girl Will Be 18.

Q: What Is The Minimum Age Of Groom To Avail The Benefits Of The Shagun Yojna ?
A: The Minimum Age Of The Girl Will Be 21.

Q: Can a widow also apply for this scheme?  
A: Yes, This Scheme Is Also For Widow Women.

Q: Will I get the benefits of this scheme if I get married in another state?  
A: Yes, The Benefit Of This Scheme Will Be Available Even If You Get Married In Another State.

Q: How much amount will be received under Himachal Pradesh Shagun Yojana 2023?  
A: The State Government Will Provide A Total Financial Assistance Of Rs.31000.

Q: Can I apply for the scheme even after getting married?  
A: Yes, The Application Can Be Made Within Six Months After The Marriage. And Application Can Also Be Made Two Months Before The Marriage.

Q: How to apply for this scheme ?
A: 1. Applicants have to go to the official website of the e-district Himachal Pradesh.
2. Follow further instructions.

A: 1. Birth certificate of girl & boy.
2. Himachali Bonafide certificate of girl issued by a competent revenue officer.

4. Copy of the bank account passbook of the applicant.

Scheme: Haryana Happy Card Free Bus Mobility Scheme
Ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Transport
Level: state

Category: Transport & Infrastructure

The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science &amp; Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.

Q: What financial support is provided to the awardees?
A: Awardees receive a consolidated monthly salary for the project duration. Additionally, there is a research grant of [?]5 lakh per annum, which includes provisions for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment necessary for implementing the project.

Q: Is there support for hiring manpower under this scheme?
A: Yes, the scheme provides need-based support for hiring one manpower personnel to assist in the research project.

Q: Can the awardee return to their parent organization after the fellowship?
A: Yes, awardees have the option to return to their parent organization after completing the tenure of the fellowship.

Q: Are there any restrictions on the location of the new workplace?
A: Yes, the new workplace must be located more than 500 km away from the applicant's current city.

Q: What is the upper age limit for applicants?
A: Applicants must be under the age of 50 to be eligible for the scheme.

Q: How can one apply for the Mobility Scheme?
A: Applicants need to prepare a detailed research proposal in their area of expertise. Five copies of the application form, including general information and the research proposal in the prescribed format, should be submitted.

Q: Where can applicants find the application format?
A: The prescribed application format is available on the Department of Science & Technology's official website.

Q: To whom should the application be sent?
A: Five copies of the application should be sent to Department of Science & Technology, Technology Bhawan, New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi-110016, by speed post.

Q: Is the scheme applicable to women scientists in private institutions?
A: No, the scheme is specifically designed for women scientists working in permanent positions in Government Institutions, R&D Labs, or Universities.

title: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi
ministry: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the monthly amount provided under the scheme?
A: Eligible women receive [?]1500 per month.

Q: What are the key objectives of the scheme?
A: To honor women's contribution to cultural heritage and ensure their economic empowerment and self-reliance.

Q: Are Buddhist nuns (chomo) eligible for the scheme?
A: Yes, Buddhist nuns living permanently in Buddhist monasteries are eligible.

Q: Who are considered 'family' under the scheme?
A: Family includes husband/wife, adult/minor sons, and unmarried daughters registered in the family register or ration card as of 31.03.2023.

Q: Who is the authorized officer for the scheme?
A: The Director of Empowerment of Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Specially Abled, H.P.

Q: How are applications processed?
A: Applications are received, sorted, and registered by the Tehsil Welfare Officer before being presented to the competent authority for approval.

Q: What happens to incomplete or ineligible applications?
A: They are sent back to the applicant with comments within 15 days.

Q: Who approves the Sukh-Samman Fund?
A: The Deputy Commissioner and Resident Commissioner of the respective districts, along with other competent officers.

Q: How is the Sukh-Samman Fund distributed?
A: The fund is distributed based on a list compiled by the Tehsil Welfare Officer and verified by competent officers.

Q: How often are beneficiaries inspected?
A: District Welfare Officer and Tehsil Welfare Officer inspect 10% and 25% of beneficiaries, respectively, each year.

Q: What is the process for closing the fund for ineligible beneficiaries?
A: The fund is permanently closed after obtaining approval from the competent authority and informing the beneficiary.

Q: What happens in case of beneficiary death?
A: The fund is closed permanently upon authorized information of the beneficiary's death.

Q: What is the procedure for handling complaints of ineligibility?
A: The fund is temporarily stopped and the complaint is investigated by the District or Tehsil Welfare Officer.

Q: What is the head of account for scheme expenditure?
A: Expenditure is made from a separate budget head, with top-up on social security pension payable from the related account head.

Q: Who maintains the records related to the scheme?
A: The Tehsil Welfare Officer is responsible for maintaining all records related to the scheme.

Q: Who audits the expenditure under the scheme? 
A: The expenditure is audited by the office of the Accountant General (Accounts), Himachal Pradesh.

title: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K
ministry: Government of Jammu and Kashmir - Department of Women & Child Development
text: Scheme: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K Ministry: Government of Jammu and Kashmir - Department of Women & Child Development Level: state State: Jammu and Kashmir Category: Women & Child The "Ladli Beti" scheme is implemented by the Government of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir through Jammu and Kashmir Bank to provide long-term financial support to eligible girl children. Under the scheme, a recurring deposit account is opened by the natural or legal guardian of the girl child. The Government contributes ₹1,000/- per month for 14 years, subject to the beneficiary's eligibility and approval by the Social Welfare Department. After the recurring deposit matures, it is converted into a cumulative term deposit account. The maturity amount is paid after the beneficiary attains the prescribed age and conditions under the scheme are fulfilled. The scheme is a hybrid deposit plan having two phases: - **Phase I:** A recurring deposit for 14 years having a date of completion as one month after the last installment received in the account.- **Phase II:** A Cumulative Term Deposit (CCR) for 7 years. After the maturity of Phase I (recurring deposit account) the account will graduate to Phase II (Cumulative Term Deposit account). The monthly contribution of ₹1000/- in Phase-I is made by the J&K Govt. The annual income of the parents from all sources should be less than ₹75,000. The required documents are the Application Form, KYC Norms of the Parent/ Guardian, and the sanction letter from the CDPO (Child Development Project Officer).

title: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K
ministry: Government of Jammu and Kashmir - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K - Benefits
Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
> **Benefits & Features:**


1. A recurring deposit account under this scheme shall be opened by the natural or legal guardian of the girl child.
1. A contribution of Rs. 1000/- per month will be made by J&K Government from the birth of the girl child/account opening date for the next 14 years.  (A total of Rs. 168000/- only will be contributed by the UT.) 
1. No credits other than a monthly contribution of Rs. 1000/- by the J&K Government is to be allowed in Phase I (RD Account) 
1. After the maturity of Phase I (recurring deposit account) the account will graduate to Phase II (Cumulative Term Deposit account).
1. No partial drawls or Foreclosure will be allowed under any circumstances during any phase. 
1. Maturity benefits under the scheme will be paid to the beneficiary on completion of 21 years of age or 21 years after the first installment or 85 months after the last installment whichever is later by crediting the savings bank account of the girl child. However, the girl child is at liberty to reinvest the amount in any deposit plan of the bank at card rates.
1. The nomination facility will not be applicable in the scheme. In the unfortunate event of the death of the girl child, the account will be closed immediately and the balance amount along with interest accrued will revert to the Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh;
1. In the event of the death of the beneficiary, before she attains 21 years of age, the amount in the Recurring Deposit account / Term Deposit account shall be closed before maturity without pre-payment charges.
1. The account opened at a particular branch may not be transferred to any other branch even if the girl child in whose name the account stands shifts to a place other than the city or locality where the account stands.
1. The beneficiary/parent or guardian of the beneficiary shall produce a ‘life certificate of the beneficiary (girl child)’ certified by a gazetted officer or by the principal of the school/ college where she is enrolled before the concerned bank branch after every three years and at the time of maturity.
1. As the scheme is aimed at households having an annual income of less than 75000/- The TDS shall not be deducted as long as the guardian/beneficiary furnishes form 15G/15H every year and has a valid PAN

title: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K
ministry: Government of Jammu and Kashmir - Department of Women & Child Development
text:
Scheme: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K - Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the age criteria for Ladli Beti Scheme?
A: The age criteria for the purpose of the Ladli Beti Scheme is that the girl child should have been born on or after 1st April 2015.

Q: What are the objectives of Ladli Beti scheme?
A: The objective of the scheme is to arrest the declining female sex ratio. The scheme further intends to ensure that the girl child does not become a burden for the parent or guardian at the time of her marriage.

Q: Who should be opening the Recurring deposit account under this scheme?
A: The Recurring deposit account under this scheme shall be opened by the natural or legal guardian of the girl child.

Q: What would be the contribution from the State/UT Government?
A: A contribution of Rs. 1000/- per month will be made by J&K Government from the birth of the girl child/account opening date for the next 14 years.  (A total of Rs. 168000/- only will be contributed by the UT.)

Q: Other Than the Monthly Contribution Of Rs. 1000/-, are there any other credits allowed In Phase I (RD Account) 
A: No credits other than monthly contribution of Rs. 1000/- by J&K Government is to be allowed in Phase I (RD Account)

Q: Are partial drawls or Foreclosures allowed under Ladli Beti Scheme?
A: No partial drawls or Foreclosure will be allowed under any circumstances during any phase.

Q: When will the maturity benefits be paid to the beneficiary?
A: Maturity benefits under the scheme will be paid to the beneficiary on completion of 21 years of age or 21 years after the first installment or 85 months after the last installment whichever is later by crediting the saving bank account of the girl child. However, the girl child is at liberty to reinvest the amount in any deposit plan of the bank at card rates.

Q: Is Nomination Facility available In this Scheme?
A: Nomination facility will not be applicable in scheme. In an unfortunate event of the death of the girl child, the account will be closed immediately and the balance amount along with interest accrued will revert to the Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh;

Q: Can The Account Opened At A Particular Branch May Not Be Transferred To Any Other Branch?
A: The account opened at a particular branch may not be transferred to any other branch even if the girl child in whose name the account stands shifts to a place other than the city or locality where the account stands.
